claim.claim-text: 2. The solar cell according to claim 1, wherein in directions normal to the plurality of side surfaces (13) of the substrate (2), the plurality of side surfaces (13) of the substrate (2) are respectively flush with edges of the doped conducting layer (3), the first passivation layer (4), and the anti-reflection layer (5) on the same sides as the plurality of side surfaces (13) of the substrate (2).
3. A method for manufacturing a solar cell, comprising:
4. The method according to claim 3, wherein the step of forming the anti-reflection layer (5) on the first passivation layer (4) comprises:

on a condition that the passivation contact layer (6) of the panel (10) faces a positioning boat (8), clamping the panel (10) by positioning protrusions (9) disposed on the positioning boat (8), and depositing an anti-reflection material on an unblocked surface area of the panel (10); and adjusting a position of the positioning protrusions (9) relative to the plurality of side surfaces (13) of the substrate (2), and depositing the anti-reflection material on the unblocked surface area of the panel (10), thereby forming the anti-reflection layer (5) on the first passivation layer (4), wherein the anti-reflection layer (5) at least covers the first passivation layer (4), the plurality of side surfaces (13), and surfaces of the passivation contact layer (6) on the same sides as the plurality of side surfaces (13).

5. The method according to claim 4, wherein on a condition that a distance is formed between the passivation contact layer (6) of the panel (10) and the positioning boat (8), the anti-reflection layer (5) is formed to further cover at least part of the passivation contact layer (6) adjacent to the plurality of side surfaces (13).
6. The method according to any one of claims 3 to 5, wherein the step of providing the panel (10) comprises:
7. A photovoltaic device, comprising at least one cell group, wherein the cell group comprises at least two solar cells (1) according to claim 1 or 2.
8. A photovoltaic system, comprising the photovoltaic device according to claim 7.
